outcome: Map one exact bounded HTTP JSON request to one snapshot-consistent Auth Service evaluation and return only its binary decision.

concurrency.model: bounded pool of independent read-only SQLite engine connections
concurrency.admission: one semaphore permit per pool slot with a bounded acquisition timeout
concurrency.execution: synchronous evaluation runs on a blocking worker outside the async executor
concurrency.epoch: all pool members share one atomic non-reusing epoch allocator
concurrency.timeout_safety: an elapsed caller deadline does not return the engine or permit until the worker exits

storage_security: Every untrusted request value is passed through SQLite parameter binding; no request value is interpolated into SQL. API startup neither migrates nor writes schema.
observability: Readiness plus aggregate counters and gauges; request identifiers, evidence references, routes, subjects, and policy facts are absent.
caller_security: Deferred product boundary: future authenticated internal caller through owner-selected mTLS or trusted edge. No listener or client-authentication implementation is in this candidate.
required_product_tests: exact ALLOW and DENY response projection
all malformed, oversized, unsupported, and unknown requests fail closed
evaluation timeout returns 504 DENY and retains the engine until safe completion
database pool uses existing schema, system clock, independent connections, and shared epochs
SQL injection strings remain data and cannot change schema
zero capacities and deadlines are rejected
strict format, compile, lint, deterministic generation, and test checks pass
claim_limit: Local product candidate contract only; no evidence join, approval, activation, publication, release, deployment, or production use.
